correctness.rationale: For every finite abelian alphabet, the checksum annihilator is exactly the diagonal character subgroup. The normalized Gram is a direct sum of all-ones blocks of orders equal to counts of symbols with occupancy at least n-r; multinomial orbit census produces exact positive eigenvalue multiplicities. Pigeonhole plus Hamming-distance arguments establish both sharp thresholds and binary odd-length unitary uniqueness. Direct 69-case matrix/orbit checker had maximum eigenvalue residual 1.03e-14, and finite data are not used as a universal proof.
